Dedicated serve on :8193 with its own OLLAMA_MODELS; request model is the tag. Modelfile params mirror the official qwen3.6 tag (presence_penalty 1.5, temperature 1); bench requests override them with presence_penalty 0 and greedy sampling. Thinking is only switched off by reasoning_effort none (renderer/parser qwen3.5, as the official tag).
